title: shawk / Changes
description: Dependencies over TCP, UDP and Unix stream sockets that appeared or disappeared. RDMA (InfiniBand, RoCE) is not observed.

target.rawSql:
SELECT time, change || ': ' || client_service || ' -> ' || server_service || ':' || port AS text, change AS tags
FROM shawk_v1.dependency_changes_between($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())

SELECT gap_start AS time, gap_end AS timeend, 'not observed: ' || host AS text, host AS tags
FROM shawk_v1.unobserved($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())

SELECT gap_start AS time, gap_end AS timeend, 'partly observed: ' || host AS text, host AS tags
FROM shawk_v1.partly_observed($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1h'), change AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM shawk_v1.dependency_changes_between($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Changes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, change, client_service, server_service, port, proto
FROM shawk_v1.dependency_changes_between($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1000

panels.description: Dependencies between services that appeared, or disappeared while a host that saw them kept observing for 15 minutes. Only TCP, UDP and Unix stream sockets are observed: a dependency over RDMA verbs (MPI, NCCL, Lustre o2ib, NFS over RDMA) neither appears nor disappears here.

panels.title: Listeners on ports the kernel chose

targets.rawSql:
SELECT service, slurm_job, proto, hosts, ports, port_min, port_max, first_seen, last_seen
FROM shawk_v1.kernel_chosen_ports
ORDER BY ports DESC, service
LIMIT 1000

panels.description: Services that listened in the last 30 days, whatever the time range, on ports the kernel chose (bound to port 0, or listening without bind), which no rule of ports covers: a server whose port changes at every run, such as srun without SrunPortRange, makes a new dependency above each time. Add the service to port_agnostic_services (slurm-job for the processes of Slurm jobs), or its ports to dynamic_ports, in the configuration of the connector; a server on every address stays listed until dynamic_ports holds every address of its host but loopback and link-local. A hint only: listeners are seen every interval of the agents, so short-lived ones are missed, and services on such ports are not one service.
